violated_contract: A reference absent from a stale, bounded or failed collection read is unresolved, not proven deleted. The memory-link card on main skipped refresh once MemoriesProvider.hasLoaded was true and rendered No longer available for a newly created memory or failed list read (#23701).
canonical_prevention: Resolve cached hits through the existing provider; on a miss use its coalesced, account-scoped refresh and hydration budget. Keep loading, unresolved/retry and resolved states distinct. Do not infer a terminal deletion from collection absence or introduce another memory writer.
